# Login to Spotify exactly once
username='ca-smit@gmail.com'
password=None
for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if item.get('account_name')=='spotify':
        password=item.get('password')
        break
print('spotify_password_found', password is not None)
spotify_token=None
res=apis.spotify.login(username=username,password=password)
print(res)
spotify_token=res.get('access_token')
print('spotify_token_set', spotify_token is not None)

queue=apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_token)
print('queue_len', len(queue))
# Show items with position, title, is_current, is_playing
print([(s['song_id'], s.get('title'), s.get('position'), s.get('is_current'), s.get('is_playing')) for s in queue])
# Determine current position
current=[s for s in queue if s.get('is_current')]
print('current_matches', current)
current_position=current[0]['position'] if current else None
print('current_position', current_position)
played=[s for s in queue if s.get('position') is not None and current_position is not None and s['position']<=current_position]
print('played_count', len(played))
print('played_song_ids', [s['song_id'] for s in played])

liked_song_ids=set()
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_pages=[]
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    # page can be [] when done
    if not page:
        break
    all_pages.append(len(page))
    for s in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    page_index+=1
print('liked_total_ids', len(liked_song_ids))
print('liked_pages_counts', all_pages)
played_song_ids=[2, 91, 168, 137, 250, 227]
to_like=[sid for sid in played_song_ids if sid not in liked_song_ids]
print('played_song_ids', played_song_ids)
print('to_like', to_like)
print('to_like_count', len(to_like))

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [2e6a3c0]: When a task requires performing an action (approve, delete, update, send) on a SUBSET of items matching criteria</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure whether all queue entries earlier than current position count as 'played so far' in this API, but position<=current_position is the intended interpretation.</uncertainty>

to_like=[2, 91, 168, 137, 250, 227]
results=[]
for sid in to_like:
    r=apis.spotify.like_song(song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    results.append((sid, r))
print('like_results', results)
# <reflection>Entry guided correct subset selection (position<=current) and avoiding already-liked songs.</reflection>
